gaps.what: Thutmose I's Levantine raid to the Euphrates, Seti I's capture of Kadesh and Amurru, the Amarna-age Syrian losses and the end of Egyptian Canaan are undated on the pages opened; the -1400, -1352 and -1077 events are bridges (confidence 1 or 2)
Sharuhen (c. 1547) and Lower Nubia (c. 1540) are dated by bridging, confidence 1; open Thutmose I, Amenhotep III, Akhenaten, Seti I, Twentieth Dynasty of Egypt, Viceroy of Kush
Cliopatria shapes -1000 and -900 are reviewed by the 21st and 22nd dossiers, so this dossier carries two no-verdict warnings

The Memphis gain is undated (confidence 1); the Seventeenth Dynasty page's 1559 BC capture of Memphis and Avaris and the 15th page's whole-Egypt conquest under Khayan conflict with the Kamose page and are not drawn
Whether Thebes fell to the Hyksos (pages disagree) and the Hyksos-vassal reading are not drawn; the Abydos Dynasty overlap is open
The 17th Dynasty page gives no territory; the Elephantine-to-Cusae limits are Kamose's time only; no Hyksos tribute or Kush alliance on any page
Nubia, the Levant, Shoshenq I and the High Priests of Amun's relation to Tanis are not on the 21st Dynasty page; the vassal tint for Thebes is a reading

How far south Shoshenq I ruled before 837 (event at confidence 1), his Levantine campaign, Osorkon II and the breakup are not on the 22nd Dynasty page; open Shoshenq I, Osorkon II, Takelot II, Twenty-fourth Dynasty of Egypt
Where the Takelot II civil war was fought, the Leontopolis land and when Kashta took Thebes are not on the pages opened; ruler strip omitted (overlapping co-regents)

problems: Cliopatria row 'New Kingdom of Egypt' (-1500..-801) was split in three: new-kingdom-of-egypt (-1550..-1077), the new twenty-first-dynasty-of-egypt (-1077..-943, reviews shape -1000) and twenty-second-dynasty-of-egypt (starts -943, reviews shape -900); each shows 'no verdict' warnings for the shapes its siblings review.

Cliopatria's Twenty-second and Twenty-third Dynasty shapes look swapped (22nd row = Upper/Middle Egypt, 23rd row = Delta; the pages put the 22nd at Bubastis/Tanis, the 23rd at Thebes/Herakleopolis); both dossiers mark them wrong and use the other row's shape. The Sixteenth Dynasty row is the eastern Delta on Avaris, not Thebes.

fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt and hyksos are one state under two Cliopatria rows (different Wikidata ids); the orchestrator must merge or demote one before colours and rendering, or the Delta is drawn twice.

The Kush dossier (af-01) gains Thebes from twenty-second-dynasty-of-egypt at -754 and Egypt at -727; these dossiers put Thebes in the 23rd Dynasty and date its loss to Kush at -728 (23rd infobox; Kush page: campaigns 728-716). Counterparts should be reconciled.
The Hyksos dossier dates the Thebes contest -1630..-1629 and ends the war -1550; this batch carries it -1630..-1582 (16th Dynasty) and -1553..-1550 (17th Dynasty).

New Kingdom page budget (5) exceeded by two pages (Kingdom of Kush and Third Intermediate Period, both opened for the 22nd/23rd dossiers and cited for Nubian and 1077 events); Kamose, 15th and 17th pages are cited in notes only.
The New Kingdom ends 1077 here (Third Intermediate Period and 21st Dynasty pages); its infobox says c. 1069.

Wikipedia pages for the Libyan-age dynasties and the 17th Dynasty are thin and contradict each other on dates (see notes); nothing is dated from memory, events resting on a silent page are confidence 1.
